title: CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting
abstract: arXiv:2610.36340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two shifts: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are quantized to satisfy resource constraints. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled corruption benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects using 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models using A100 TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision, paired with throughput and energy measurements from corresponding Jetson Orin NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our evaluation shows that capture-chain corruptions consistently produce the largest degradation across the evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative error differ

translated_title: CrowdCC：人群计数中损坏鲁棒性与部署量化的联合基准测试
translated_abstract: 部署在边缘设备上的人群计数模型面临两种变化：输入在采集和传输管道中发生降质，同时模型需要被量化以满足资源限制。然而，损坏鲁棒性与部署量化通常被分开评估。我们提出了CrowdCC，一个受控损坏基准，联合评估这些影响：使用23种面向部署场景的损坏类型（涵盖三个严重程度）、四个人群计数数据集和26个模型，采用A100 TensorRT引擎在FP32、FP16和训练后INT8精度下运行，并搭配相应Jetson Orin NX配置的吞吐量和能耗测量。这些损坏涵盖六个类别，并在几何或可见性发生变化时对头部标注进行调整。我们的评估显示，采集链损坏在所有评估模型中始终造成最大的性能下降，而人群密度对绝对误差和相对误差的影响各不相同。
tldr: 该论文提出CrowdCC基准，首次联合评估人群计数模型在图像损坏退化与部署量化（FP32/FP16/INT8）下的表现，发现采集链类损坏对所有模型造成的性能下降最为严重。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CrowdCC, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate corruption robustness and deployment quantization (FP32/FP16/INT8) in crowd counting, finding that capture-chain corruptions consistently cause the largest degradation across models.
